item.title: Gracie Abrams Charges to No. 1 In Australia With ‘Daughter From Hell’
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! This week, we've got some exciting updates on the ARIA Charts. Let's dive right in!
[Music transitions]
Host: "Gracie Abrams is taking the top spot on the ARIA Albums Chart with her latest release, 'Daughter From Hell'. This is her second number one album, following 'The Secret Of Us' back in 2024-25. And get this - 'Daughter From Hell' is also the best-selling vinyl of the week!
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "Meanwhile, Olivia Rodrigo's 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love' slips down to number two, and Olivia Dean takes the third spot with 'The Art of Loving'. We're seeing a strong female presence on the charts this week!
[Music transitions]
Host: "In other news, Motionless in White has debuted at number five with their seventh studio album, 'Decades'. This is their highest chart position yet, and their first time in the top 10. And Steve Lacy's 'Oh Yeah' enters the chart at number 19.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "On the ARIA Singles Chart, Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is still going strong, spending its seventh non-consecutive week at number one. And female artists are dominating the top three, with Olivia Dean's 'Man I Need' and her collaboration with Sam Fender, 'Rein Me In', holding steady at numbers two and three.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for this week's update. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard! We'll see you next time with more music news and updates."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
